title: MASD — Member Activity Summary
description: Adoption target fulfilment, activity intensity and malnutrition outcomes for the F2F-trained learners of a project — the district report, computed live from NurtureHUB's own records.
downloadFailed: The download could not be prepared. Please try again.
loadFailed: The report could not be loaded.
noLearnersTitle: No F2F-trained learners in this project yet
noLearners: Select learners for face-to-face training on the Results page; their adoptions and activities will appear here.

calendar.prorated: Ideal counted pro rata while follow-up runs: tranche 1 {{t1}}% due, tranche 2 {{t2}}% due
calendar.full: Follow-up complete for both tranches — ideal is the full 98 activities (66 for Staff Nurses)
calendar.inferred: Dates inferred from the data — set them in Programme settings

overview.findingsSub: Written from the data each time the report is computed
overview.mixSub: The programme expects one of each type per tranche
overview.nonF2f: {{n}} learners outside F2F training also registered {{cases}} cases — they are not counted in this report.
overview.weeklySub: Everything F2F learners filed each week since training, with new adoptions below

attention.sub: No activity yet, silent for 14+ days, under 40% intensity, or under half the adoption target
attention.none: Nobody needs a call right now.

activity.fulfilSub: % of the adoption target met and % of the ideal activities done
activity.bubbleSub: Right = more cases adopted · up = more follow-up · bubble size = learners · dashed lines = averages
activity.dataSub: With average days since the last activity
activity.subtypeSub: % of the ideal count done, per activity type — green ≥80%, amber 60–79%, red below
activity.targetsSub: Adoptions and activities, with department subtotals
activity.distributionSub: F2F learners; the share is of that block's learners

progress.noneTitle: Pick an earlier date to compare with
progress.none: Choose a comparison date before the report date, and this page shows how every block and cadre has moved since.
progress.title: {{then}} vs {{now}}
progress.sub: The same report computed for both dates
progress.uwSub: Share below −2 SD weight-for-age at the adoption visit (AV) and the last visit (LV)

reasons.no_child: No child ID – child not born yet / not followed up
reasons.no_adoption_details: Birth details available but no adoption details
reasons.mother_after_lv: Mother adoption date is after the child's last visit
reasons.birth_weight_extreme: Birth weight below −6 SD or above +6 SD
reasons.birth_vs_visit1: Birth weight vs first-visit weight mismatch
reasons.dob_vs_visit1: Date of birth vs first-visit date mismatch
reasons.adoption_vs_visit: Adoption date vs adoption-visit date mismatch
reasons.z_missing: Weight z-score at BV/AV/LV is missing
reasons.baby_before_mother: Invalid: baby adopted before the mother

outcomes.funnelTitle: Who is in the outcome analysis
outcomes.funnelSub: From every learner with a registered case to the F2F-eligible cases
outcomes.funnelStart: Every learner with a registered case
outcomes.exclSub: Mother-child dyads; the first failed check is the reason
outcomes.retentionSub: How many of each cadre's learners and cases reach the final analysis
outcomes.familyTypeNote: Family type is not collected in NurtureHUB's mother registration, so it is not shown.
outcomes.prevTitle: Malnutrition: birth → adoption visit → last visit
outcomes.prevSub: Share below −2 SD: stunting (length-for-age), underweight (weight-for-age), wasting (weight-for-length)
outcomes.noCohort: No cases in this group pass the data checks yet.
outcomes.noBenchmark: No NFHS benchmark is set for this project — add one in Programme settings to compare against it.
outcomes.bandsTitle: By age band: MT+FL vs other learners
outcomes.bandsSub: Adoption visit (AV) against last visit (LV), with the NFHS figure for the same age band
outcomes.complianceSub: Cases that met the visit rule against those that did not
outcomes.complianceRule: {{visits}}+ growth checks with at least {{days}} days of follow-up
outcomes.fixesTitle_one: {{count}} learner has cases waiting on a data correction
outcomes.fixesTitle_other: {{count}} learners have cases waiting on a data correction
outcomes.fixesSub: Excluded for a data-entry problem, not for missing follow-up — correcting them brings the case back into the analysis
outcomes.fixesNone: No case is excluded for a data-entry problem.

learners.hint: Mark Master Trainers and Facilitators here — the outcome pages compare their cases with everyone else's. Adoptions are shown as total (ANC · <5M · ≥5M).
learners.roleFailed: Could not save the change. Please try again.

rules.prorataNote: While a tranche's follow-up is still running, the ideal activity count is taken pro rata, so an interim report does not charge learners for visits that were not due yet. Once the follow-up is over it is the full count.
rules.idealTitle: Ideal activity count per learner, by tranche
rules.idealSub: Both tranches together: {{std}} activities per learner, {{nurse}} for Staff Nurses

adoption.meaning: A mother — and her child once born — taken on by a learner: a mother-child dyad.

types.meaning: Adopted while pregnant; or after birth with the child younger than {{days}} days (5 months); or {{days}} days or older.

target.meaning: Adoptions ÷ {{target}} expected per learner — one of each type per tranche (a Staff Nurse: three PNC <5M per tranche).

intensity.meaning: Assessment forms filed ÷ the ideal count for the learner: antenatal care, protein count, growth monitoring, breastfeeding and complementary feeding.

nil.meaning: Days from the learner's last recorded activity to the report date.

bvavlv.meaning: Birth details (from child registration) · the adoption visit (baseline) · the last visit (endline).

mtfl.meaning: Master Trainers and Facilitators — F2F learners marked on the Learners page.

bands.meaning: <6 months = ANC and PNC <5M adoptions; 6–11 months = PNC ≥5M adoptions, as in the NFHS comparison.

malnutrition.meaning: WHO z-score below −2 for length-for-age, weight-for-age and weight-for-length.

rules.checksTitle: Data checks for the outcome analysis
rules.checksSub: Applied in this order; a case's first failed check is its exclusion reason
